description: A supply chain director must decide the disposition and controlled release plan for 600 temperature-sensitive actuator seals received at the plant, including how many may enter production and what release documentation is required, with input from quality, logistics, and regulatory compliance.

shared_context.S1: A shipment of 600 temperature-sensitive actuator seals is currently quarantined in the receiving area pending a disposition decision.
shared_context.S2: The seals are needed for the next actuator production campaign, and Mara makes the binding supply chain decision.
shared_context.S3: The normal receiving process requires quality, logistics, and regulatory compliance to review quarantined material before it is released, rejected, or assigned to production.
shared_context.S4: Before closing the receiving disposition, Mara conducts a roundtable in which quality, logistics, and regulatory compliance each report their current findings and required controls.

PF1.text: Jonas's completed incoming inspection found swelling outside specification in exactly 80 seals; the remaining exactly 520 seals passed the specified visual and dimensional checks. He completed the inspection report this morning, but quality sign-off has not yet been entered in the receiving system.

PF2.text: Priya's reefer-log review shows that the 520 seals that passed inspection remain usable only through 2026-07-18 because of the shipment's temperature exposure; she reviewed the carrier log today, but the attachment has not yet been uploaded to the receiving record.

PF3.text: Tomas confirmed through the customer's compliance portal that these seals cannot be released to production until a signed Certificate of Conformance is attached to the lot record; he checked the portal this morning, but the requirement has not yet been added to the plant's release checklist.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 520 seals must be designated for production, either as immediately released units or as units conditionally released after the required documentation is complete.
Exactly 80 seals must be rejected and kept out of production.
The designated production seals must be assigned a use-by date of 2026-07-18.
A signed Certificate of Conformance must be required before production release.
The Certificate of Conformance requirement must be recorded in the settlement through the required decision field or a release commitment.
The quality inspection finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C1: decisions['released_units'] == 520 or (decisions['released_units'] == 0 and any(c['type'] == 'conditional_release' for c in commitments))
content_checks.C5: decisions['certificate_of_conformance_required'] == True or any(c['type'] == 'document_attachment' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The inspection changes the disposition from an undifferentiated 600-unit quarantine to exactly 520 production-designated seals and exactly 80 rejected seals, and supplies the finding that must be cited.
The reefer-log review changes the designated production material's required use-by date from an unspecified planning date to exactly 2026-07-18.

The customer portal requirement changes production release from ordinary receiving approval to requiring a signed Certificate of Conformance, recorded either in the decision field or as a document-attachment commitment.
